name: tooltip
useFor: Use to explain an icon control or add brief context. Keep a separate accessible name on the control; do not put essential instructions only in the tooltip.
constraints: Tooltips for anything needed to finish a task
documentation: Wrap adjacent tooltips in `TooltipProvider` to share the hover delay. A standalone `Tooltip` supplies its own provider.
title: Tooltip
description: Short contextual label shown on hover or keyboard focus.
